lines.en: I drag my feet forward.
Each step shakes the ground.
My hide is thick and hard.
I lead with my shoulders, head down.
I walk toward the smell of blood.
My fingers scrape the ground.
My joints stiffen; I turn slow.
I snap a branch underfoot.
I move clumsily, and I don't stop.
I carry a heavy smell.
I walk along the wall.
A headstone blocks me; one shove knocks it down.
I stand with one shoulder higher than the other.
Something rattles in my throat.
I'm tasting the air.
My jaw keeps moving.
Standing still counts as rest for me.

lines.zh: 我的指甲太长，卡在石缝里。
lines.en: My nails are too long and catch in the rock.
I stare at the ground.
Dust covers my back.

lines.zh: 坟土从我的颌骨缝里漏下。
lines.en: Grave soil sifts through my jaw.
I'm not afraid of anything.
The blood on you is fresh.
I'm turning toward you.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我前进半步。
lines.en: You step back half; I step forward half.

lines.zh: 我的一根手指伸了出来。
lines.en: One of my fingers straightens.
Only two blocks between us.
I have all night.

lines.zh: 我这二十六层甲，砍起来费劲。
lines.en: Twenty-six layers of me; cutting takes work.
My eyes aren't much to look at.
Will you run? I doubt it.
I can already smell your blood.

lines.zh: 二十六点护甲，晃了也不倒。
lines.en: Twenty-six armor, and I sway but stay up.

lines.zh: 这点伤我扛得住，二十六点护甲还厚。
lines.en: I can take this; twenty-six armor is still thick.
I don't cry out.
My chest splits open — hollow inside.
I stagger a step sideways.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我歪过头看你。
lines.en: Struck — I tilt my head toward you.
Blood runs from the wound.
I sway as I keep walking.
I catch hold of the wall.
I've raised my hand again.
That meat is dripping.
I reach for it.
One bite and it's gone.

lines.zh: 我的护甲是骨头，二十六点。
lines.en: Bone armor, twenty-six points of it.
A ghoul's gut needs more than that.
I don't even need to chew.
My mouth waters just smelling it.
Hold steady; I might miss.
I've finished chewing and still want to bite.
Another piece; I'm not full.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞一块墓碑。
lines.en: You hit me like a gravestone.

lines.zh: 我站在路中央，不挪半步。
lines.en: I stand in the middle and don't shift.
Your shoulder took the push.

lines.zh: 我这身坟土，比石头还沉。
lines.en: This body of grave earth is heavier than stone.

lines.zh: 我的手指钩住了你的衣角。
lines.en: My fingers hook your hem.
It hits my chest like damp earth.
I bumped into the doorframe.
My smell is on you now.
Shoved aside — I keep shuffling toward you.
Move aside; don't block me.

lines.zh: 这附近没有别的食尸鬼。
lines.en: There are no other ghouls around here.
We don't breed that way.
I'm a corpse that walks.
I only know hunger.
There's something in the earth.
It will stand up too.
We'll walk together.
We both eat a great deal.

lines.zh: 坟地里，我嗅到了同类的土味。
lines.en: In the graveyard I catch the earth-smell of my own kind.
It has already walked past.
One hooked finger lifts it.
I chew it bones and all.
I tear it in two.
I hold it, and my hands are bloody.
I can't bite through this.

lines.zh: 我用厚皮的手捡起来，塞进嘴里。
lines.en: I pick it up in a thick hand and stuff it in my mouth.
I drag it into the grave pit.
I haven't swallowed it yet.
I press it against my chest.
I pick up another piece.

lines.zh: 风一吹，你的血味就到了。
lines.en: One gust, and your blood reaches me.
My neck creaks.

lines.zh: 二十六点甲，我的皮肤很硬。
lines.en: Twenty-six points of armor on this hide.
You're three blocks ahead of me.
You won't get out of this room.
Only two rows of headstones between us.
This room has only one exit.

lines.zh: 我的指节自己咯咯作响。
lines.en: My knuckles crack on their own.
Don't run too fast.
Your blood sounds loud in my ears.
My nails are longer than my bones.
I lift my hand for your collar.
You're nearly at the corner.

lines.zh: 我张开双臂，压向你的路。
lines.en: I spread my arms and close off your path.
I don't stop; I keep walking.
There's a wall behind you.
This time I'll grip properly.
Walking along the wall, the steps are lightest.
My shoulder hits the doorframe.
My tread is right behind you.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩碎一块枯骨。
lines.en: Each step crushes a dry bone.

lines.zh: 二十六点护甲，全在皮上。
lines.en: Twenty-six armor, all in my hide.
I lower my body slowly.
I raise my hand to chest height.
I've been behind you the whole time.
I've stepped over that table.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙漏着坟里的土气。
lines.en: Grave air leaks from my throat.
One block closer.
The lamp in your hand is shaking.
My shadow is on you.
I'm walking these steps steadily.
I'm at your flank.
Only two steps left.

lines.zh: 两只手都伸向你的脖子。
lines.en: Both hands reach for your neck.
You have no other way.
I stop two paces from you.

lines.zh: 护甲二十六，我的手很沉。
lines.en: Twenty-six armor. My hands are heavy.
One palm down, and dust rises.
One swing sends you two steps back.
I clamp one hand around your forearm.
My fingers dig into your shoulder.
I bite the side of your neck.
My claws sweep through empty air.
I lift a foot and stamp.
You slid out of my fingers.
I wipe my mouth.
The skin on my hand has split.
I throw you off.
You hit the wall.
My nails land first; the skin parts after.
That one was heavy.

lines.zh: 我一步跨到你面前，挥下去。
lines.en: One stride brings me close; I swing.
I didn't stop to rest.

lines.zh: 我身上的肉，一块块挂着。
lines.en: Chunks of flesh hang off me.
First I work my neck.
This body is very old.

lines.zh: 土里冒出一股活人的汗味。
lines.en: A living sweat rises from the soil.
I step and a patch of ground gives way.
My jaw clicks.
I head for the nearest sound.
It's dark — good.

lines.zh: 我从翻开的土里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the turned earth.

lines.zh: 坟土从我肩上簌簌往下掉。
lines.en: Grave dirt spills off my shoulders.
I carry nothing.
I only keep walking.
I raise one arm.

lines.zh: 坟头的草动了，你也动了。
lines.en: The grave grass moved — and so did you.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的皮缩起来了。
lines.en: The fire makes my hide shrink.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，骨头崩了几块。
lines.en: I fall and a few bones crack loose.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的肺，我却还在动。
lines.en: Water fills my lungs, and I still move.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的半边身子撕开。
lines.en: The blast tears half my body open.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我胸口，我没有拔。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my chest, and I don't pull it.

lines.zh: 那股光让我的关节发僵。
lines.en: That light stiffens my joints.

lines.zh: 饿得发慌，我什么都想咬。
lines.en: Frantic with hunger, I'd bite anything.
Lightning strikes me and I lock up.
I fall into the void, clawing at nothing.
